Intel & Info

Is there an earning limit?

There is no cap on how many Store Coins you can hold. Every completed eligible purchase adds to your balance.

Do the coins expire?

Store Coins do not expire. They stay in your StoreLink wallet until you use them toward a discount.

Which stores accept coins?

Verified vendors on StoreLink can participate in the loyalty program. Look for the loyalty banner in your bag at checkout.

What is the 5% rule?

To keep the network healthy, you can apply coins for a discount up to 5% of your cart total at any single store.
